blocks.text: Analytical chemistry is the science of chemical characterization. A complete chemical characterization of a compound must include both qualitative and quantitative analyses. In qualitative analysis, the chemist is concerned with the detection or identification of the elements present in a compound, whereas in quantitative analysis, the relative amounts of elements in compounds are determined.
A complete quantitative determination generally consists of four major steps
In this chapter, some basic separation techniques are discussed here to practice in the lab.
